args.query: community college enrollment dual enrollment New Hampshire

sql: SELECT i.inst_name, f."year", f.eftotlt FROM edu.ipeds_fall_enrollment f JOIN edu.ipeds_institutions i ON i.unitid=f.unitid AND i."year"=f."year" WHERE f.efalevel=1 AND f."year" IN (2014,2023) AND i.state_abbr='NH' AND (i.inst_name ILIKE '%NHTI%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%Great Bay%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%Lakes Region%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%Manchester Community%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%Nashua Community%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%White Mountains Community%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%River Valley Community%' OR i.inst_name ILIKE '%Community College%') ORDER BY i.inst_name, f."year"

A claim the warehouse does not carry (an agency's new release, a company announcement, a cited study) MUST still be graded from the primary source with web_fetch, and from web_search when the source is not linked. 'not checkable here' is only for a personal attack or a claim that is an opinion or belief no evidence can test ('chocolate chip cookies are the best cookies'), marked kind: opinion, with a reason saying in one sentence why no evidence can test it (an opinion of taste, a belief, or figurative speech); a missing table or a page that will not load never makes a factual claim uncheckable; when nothing found supports it, it is 'unsupported'. For an opinion that may imply a checkable fact ('politician A is a crook'), the claim's reason MUST state whether the speaker meant it literally, from the context. Meant literally ('has committed crimes'), the implied fact MUST be split out as its own claim, searched for (a criminal record) and graded; meant figuratively ('is dishonest'), it stays an opinion. 7.
